backend/main.mo: Primary backend canister handling user profiles, security questions map, Stripe configuration, and access-controlled checkout/session APIs.
backend/migration.mo: Defines old/new actor state and migrates existing userProfiles while initializing an empty security-questions map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping security‑questions onboarding and account-recovery features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of prewritten summaries for various frontend files covering UI pages, hooks, utilities, and Stripe integration components.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining color variables, dark mode styles, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React SPA via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router routes with authentication checks and includes pages for security questions and account recovery.
frontend/src/components/ai/AICaptionGene: UI component for generating and copying client‑side social media caption suggestions using local utilities.
frontend/src/components/billing/StripeBu: Wrapper component that loads the Stripe Buy Button script and renders the embedded checkout element with fallback states.
frontend/src/components/billing/StripeCh: UI panel for editing and validating Stripe checkout URLs and saving them to localStorage.
frontend/src/components/billing/UpgradeT: Displays upgrade options based on subscription tier and triggers Stripe checkout or Buy Button flow.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Top-level layout that loads the Stripe Buy Button script and renders header, footer, and routed content.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer showing copyright, links, and attribution with a dynamic app identifier.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header with navigation, login/logout handling, and user authentication state display.
frontend/src/components/security/Securit: Form for creating and validating multiple security questions with dynamic add/remove functionality.
frontend/src/config/stripeCheckoutConfig: LocalStorage-backed utilities for getting, saving, and validating Stripe checkout configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication using Dfinity AuthClient, including login state and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps react-query to fetch, refresh, and save the caller’s user profile via an actor, handling actor readiness and cache invalidation.
React-query hooks for checking, setting, verifying, and resetting security questions through the backend actor with detailed error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useStripeBuyButtonScr: Loads the Stripe Buy Button script once using a shared promise and exposes loading state through a React hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoRecorder.ts: Implements a video recording hook using MediaRecorder with controls for start, stop, pause, resume, and blob URL management.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base, component, and utility layers with custom CSS variables for theming in light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with react-query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AccountRecoveryPage.t: UI page for account recovery that verifies and resets security questions using hooks, managing multi-step form state and errors.
frontend/src/pages/CameraPage.tsx: Camera capture and recording page that manages camera access, photo capture, video recording, and redirects users without security questions.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard showing profile data, subscription tier, and tools, with redirects if security questions are not set up.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Public landing page showcasing product features and directing users to sign in or access their dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login screen using Internet Identity authentication with redirects based on security-question setup.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentCancelPage.tsx: Page shown after a canceled checkout session with options to retry or return to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Confirmation page shown after successful payment with a button to return to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/SecurityQuestionsSetu: Page that checks if a user has security questions set, shows a setup form, handles submission, and redirects to the dashboard once completed.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Renders the Terms of Service page with styled sections covering usage, licensing, accounts, and subscriptions.
frontend/src/types/stripe-buy-button.d.t: Adds TypeScript JSX type definitions for the custom stripe-buy-button web component.
frontend/src/utils/captionGenerator.ts: Generates three caption suggestions using tone- and platform-specific templates, emojis, and CTAs based on user input.
frontend/src/utils/subscriptionTier.ts: Provides helper functions to label subscription tiers and check whether a user is on Free or Pro.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, with support for hash-based routing and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme colors, typography, animations, plugins, and layout options.
project_state.json: Defines current project state for implementing account recovery via user-defined security questions, lists existing and requested features, and notes email-disabled constraints. Includes architectural notes, known issues, and pending backend changes for secure password-reset functionality.
